description: Business Impact Analysis - Systematic process assessing operational and financial impacts resulting from system disruptions or disasters.
Business Continuity Plan - Comprehensive plan outlining procedures to keep critical business operations running during and after a major disruption.
Disaster Recovery Plan - Technical plan detailing restoring IT infrastructure, systems, and data following an emergency or disaster.
Continuity of Operations Planning - U.S. government/defense terminology for business continuity planning to sustain essential functions.
Recovery Time Objective - Maximum acceptable duration system downtime can last before unacceptable business damage occurs.
Recovery Point Objective - Maximum acceptable period of data loss measured in time, dictating data backup frequency.
Mean Time to Repair/Recover - Average time required to repair, troubleshoot, and restore a failed system component to operation.
Mean Time Between Failures - Average expected operational time between inherent system failures for repairable components.
Mean Time to Failure - Expected lifespan or average operational duration of a non-repairable system component before complete failure.
Single Loss Expectancy - Estimated financial loss incurred each time a specific asset threat event occurs (SLE = Asset Value × Exposure Factor).
Annualized Rate of Occurrence - Estimated frequency or probability that a specific risk threat event will occur within a single year.
Annualized Loss Expectancy - Total expected annual financial loss for a risk (ALE = Single Loss Expectancy × Annualized Rate of Occurrence).
Return on Investment - Performance metric calculating the financial gain or efficiency of an investment relative to its cost.
Total Cost of Ownership - Comprehensive evaluation of all direct and indirect costs associated with purchasing, operating, and maintaining an asset over its lifecycle.
